name: Navigation consolidation increment (13 files, +136/−132) is uncommitted and unowned — commit it and prove the 6 removed GlobalSettings tabs are still reachable
description:
## Why this card exists (PM shift 37, 2026-11-27T11:05Z)

The company↔active-project increment is now in HEAD (its 5 files no longer appear in `project_changes`), but a **new increment appeared after that commit and has no owner, no card and no demo**: 13 source files, +136/−132, measured this shift with `project_changes(scope="all")`. Everything else in the tree is `.codx` control-plane churn.

## What is in the increment (measured, not guessed)

| File | Change | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `src/components/layout/AppsSection.vue` | +51/−37 | Sidebar gains **Home**, **Team**, **Coworking**, **Wiki** nav items moved to the top; **Browser sessions** nav item and the pin-project button + `ViewModeToggle` removed from the header |
| `src/components/layout/DesktopSidebar.vue` | +20/−21 | **Home** nav item added to the company shell |
| `src/components/main-menu/MainMenuItems.vue` | +23/−8 | File menu: **Home** now calls `$ui.openApp('home')` instead of `$ui.setActiveTab('home')`; new **Desktop** toggle switch; **Knowledge** entry removed |
| `src/components/main-menu/WindowsMenuItems.vue` | +26/−9 | **Desktop** toggle added; `chats`, `profiles`, `knowledge` actions removed |
| `src/components/main-menu/SettingsMenu.vue` | −7 | Settings menu entries removed |
| `src/components/project/CodxDropdown.vue` | −8 | Entry removed |
| `src/views/GlobalSettings.vue` | −28 | **6 settings tabs removed**: `scripts`, `oauth`, `plugins`, `chat` (Chat Prompts), `efforts`, `traefik` — imports, `<component v-if>` blocks, tab list and descriptions |
| `src/config/features.js` | +1/−1 | `team` app now gated by the **`profiles`** feature instead of `teams` |
| `NewProject.vue`, `SetupAssistantLauncher.vue`, `WorkspaceWizard.vue` | small | Follow-up wiring changes |

## The risk this card must settle first

`project_locate("EffortsSettings")` after the change returns **only the component definition** — its single importer was `GlobalSettings.vue` and that import is deleted. The same shape applies to `OAuthSettings`, `PluginsEditor`, `TraefikRulesPanel`, `ChatGlobalPrompts`. So unless another settings surface hosts them, **this increment silently removes 6 admin screens from the product**, including the **Efforts** editor that cards `53ed97fc` (GO/NO-GO) and `2cd6e1f6` (M1 demo) depend on for their demo.

## What to do

1. For each of the 6 removed tabs (`scripts`, `oauth`, `plugins`, `chat`, `efforts`, `traefik`) **name the file+line that still renders it**. If one does not exist, do **not** commit the removal: either restore the tab or stop and report it as a scope change for management.
2. Verify the **`team` → `profiles`** feature remap in `src/config/features.js` does not hide the Team nav item for accounts that had `teams` but not `profiles` (the nav item is `v-if="appEnabled('team')"`).
3. Verify `ViewModeToggle` is still reachable from somewhere (it was removed from `AppsSection.vue`; the Desktop toggle in the menubar is meant to replace it — confirm parity with `$navigation.isDesktopMode`).
4. Commit the increment (conventional message, the 13 files above, no `.codx/**` churn).

## Acceptance

- Evidence line "tab X is rendered at path:line" for all 6 tabs, **or** the removal reverted/flagged.
- Commit sha reported; `project_changes(scope="all")` afterwards shows no source files left, only `.codx/**`.
- Build/lint green where a runtime exists (note: no node in this runtime — see `91411767`; if it cannot run, say so explicitly instead of claiming green).

## Not in this increment (deliberately)

Feature-flag rollout switch, new HomeView content, wiki page updates.

### Step 0 — measure the current tree (do this first, do not trust this card's list)
Run `project_changes(scope="all", include_patch=False, max_files=50)`.

```
src/components/layout/DesktopSidebar.vue       +20/-21

src/components/project/CodxDropdown.vue          -8
src/components/setup/SetupAssistantLauncher.vue  ±1
src/components/setup/WorkspaceWizard.vue       +8/-8
src/config/features.js                         +1/-1
src/views/GlobalSettings.vue                    -28
src/views/HomeView.vue                          -14
src/components/layout/MoreSection.vue           -28
```

If the real set differs, **commit what is actually there** and correct this card with a comment naming the difference — this is the third time this increment has been found uncommitted, so a fresh measurement beats my list.

### Step 1 — commit
1. Stage **only the product source files** listed by step 0. Never stage `.codx/**` — that is control-plane churn, not product.
2. One commit, message shape:
   `feat(nav): consolidate navigation — Home/Desktop toggle, team→profiles, drop pin+ViewModeToggle`
   Body: the file list, and one line per user-visible behaviour change.
3. Report in a comment: the **commit sha**, the file count, and `git status --short` showing the source tree clean.
4. If the commit path is refused by the worktree config, say so with the exact error and stop — the fix is delivered but its live replay is card `53132988`, not this one. Do not spend the run fighting it.

### Step 2 — prove the 6 removed GlobalSettings tabs are still reachable
The diff removes entries from `SettingsMenu.vue` and 28 lines from `GlobalSettings.vue`, and remaps `team` → `profiles` in `features.js`. Before this ships: for each of the removed entries, state **where it now lives** — a route, a menu item in another file, or "intentionally removed".

If any entry is neither reachable nor intentionally removed, that is a **regression**: do not hide it. Report it on this card and leave the commit in place with the finding recorded — the demo on 2026-11-28 needs a verdict, not a green light.

### Acceptance
- A commit sha on this card, source files only, `.codx/**` excluded.
- `MoreSection.vue` and `HomeView.vue` deletions explicitly accounted for (they were not in the original 13-file list).
- A reachability line per removed setting: `entry → where it lives now | intentionally removed`.

### Out of scope
The browser demo (`88e7b3d6`, 2026-11-28T09:00Z), the company↔active-project isolation files (already in HEAD), the QA verdict (`9e124b86`, parked), and anything under `src/api`.
